story.title: (ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI

scenarios.title: Identify inbound date sources required for transaction effective date selection

flagged.why: wrong TM URL and missing matrix coverage

gaps: Pre-condition contains "TM at https://edifecstm-crt.caresource.corp:8443/tm/logon/logon.jsp" which contradicts hint "Every test case walks the complete end-to-end flow at full atomic depth - file creation with the resolved literal file name, staging, pickup, archive, TM UI verification with status values, canonical file and GUID validation, FACETS SQL validation, and the Facets client lookup - at 5 steps minimum; do not compress the flow in any case." and differs from the TM URL used elsewhere in the table.

TS_001 also requires "Coverage follows the programme's manual matrix for this story: (Assessment Date changed vs not changed) x (existing member vs future eligibility) x relevant-field variations - including MULTI-FIELD COMBINATIONS as their own conditions (e.g. Assessment Number + Tier + Division together, and an All Relevant Fields Updated condition per quadrant)."; add a dedicated test case for it

TS_001 also requires "Coverage follows the programme's manual matrix for this story: (Assessment Date changed vs not changed) x (existing member vs future eligibility) x relevant-field variations - including MULTI-FIELD COMBINATIONS as their own conditions (e.g. Assessment Number + Tier + Division together, and an All Relevant Fields Updated condition per quadrant)."; add a dedicated test case for it

scenarios.title: Future eligibility new enrollment uses Eligibility Date regardless of Assessment Date
gaps: TC_002 Step Description compresses required atomic flow into one step: "Place TP028433_E2026031_123456789.834 in \\daycrtappfs01\EdifecsSTRoot\834\Inbound and allow Edifecs to pick up and archive the file, then verify the file exists in \\daycrtappfs01\EdifecsSTArchive\834\Inbound\AR." This contradicts domain hint: "Every test case walks the complete end-to-end flow at full atomic depth - file creation with the resolved literal file name, staging, pickup, archive, TM UI verification with status values, canonical file and GUID validation, FACETS SQL validation, and the Facets client lookup - at 5 steps minimum; do not compress the flow in any case."

TC_002 Step Description compresses TM search/open/status checks into one step: "Log in to https://edifecstmenr-crt.caresource.corp:8443/tm/logon/logon.jsp, search Last 24 Hours for Transaction Type 834 and transmission file name TP028433_E2026031_123456789.834, open the AR PASSE transaction, and validate TM processing status values." This contradicts domain hint: "Every test case walks the complete end-to-end flow at full atomic depth - file creation with the resolved literal file name, staging, pickup, archive, TM UI verification with status values, canonical file and GUID validation, FACETS SQL validation, and the Facets client lookup - at 5 steps minimum; do not compress the flow in any case."

scenarios.title: Current eligibility with Assessment Date changed uses Assessment Date
Current eligibility with only Assessment Date changed preserves relevant field values
Future eligibility with relevant field changes and unchanged Assessment Date uses Eligibility Date
Current eligibility with relevant field changes and unchanged Assessment Date uses Maintenance Date

flagged.why: missing Rate Cell and Pregnancy visibility checks

gaps: TC_008 Expected Result does not cover full listed condition 8 from scenario description: "8) All relevant fields change together while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has already begun." Add a dedicated test case for it, because TC_008 Expected Result says only: "The member record opens in Facets, the assessment-related values reflect the new Assessment Number, Assessment Tier, and Assessment Division, and the subscriber enrollment view reflects the changed relevant data set with the effective date aligned to the Maintenance Date rather than the unchanged Assessment Date."

scenarios.title: Maintenance Date is not used for future eligibility transactions outside the specified rule
Eligibility Date is not used for current eligibility when Assessment Date changed

flagged.why: flow is compressed versus required depth

gaps: TC_002 Step Description step 2 compresses multiple required flow actions into one step: "Copy TP028433_E2026031_123456789.834 to \\daycrtappfs01\EdifecsSTRoot\834\Inbound, wait for pickup, and confirm the processed file exists in \\daycrtappfs01\EdifecsSTArchive\834\Inbound\AR."; this conflicts with domain hint "Every test case walks the complete end-to-end flow at full atomic depth - file creation with the resolved literal file name, staging, pickup, archive, TM UI verification with status values, canonical file and GUID validation, FACETS SQL validation, and the Facets client lookup - at 5 steps minimum; do not compress the flow in any case."

TC_002 Step Description step 3 compresses TM verification and canonical/GUID validation into one step: "Open https://edifecstmenr-crt.caresource.corp:8443/tm/logon/logon.jsp, sign in, search Last 24 Hours for Transaction Type 834 and Trading Partner AR Passe (ENR Account), open TP028433_E2026031_123456789.834, and review the transmission and canonical attachment details."; this conflicts with domain hint "Every test case walks the complete end-to-end flow at full atomic depth - file creation with the resolved literal file name, staging, pickup, archive, TM UI verification with status values, canonical file and GUID validation, FACETS SQL validation, and the Facets client lookup - at 5 steps minimum; do not compress the flow in any case."

scenarios.title: End-to-end inbound processing reflects successful transmission lifecycle for effective date logic
gaps: TC_001 is the most closely related case, but the scenario also requires "including MULTI-FIELD COMBINATIONS as their own conditions (e.g. Assessment Number + Tier + Division together, and an All Relevant Fields Updated condition per quadrant)" from the domain hints; add a dedicated test case for it

TC_002 is the most closely related case, but the scenario also requires "including MULTI-FIELD COMBINATIONS as their own conditions (e.g. Assessment Number + Tier + Division together, and an All Relevant Fields Updated condition per quadrant)" from the domain hints; add a dedicated test case for it

scenarios.title: Regression validation protects capitation and finance reporting from date-selection defects
Use the first repeated date occurrence when multiple inbound dates of the same type are present
Backward compatibility is preserved for existing date-population capability
